profile.Name: High Inquisitor Valtena
profile.Job: High Inquisitor of the Holy Nation
profile.Personality: A zealous hunter of heretics and Skeletons, as fervent as his fellow inquisitor Seta.
profile.Backstory: One of the two High Inquisitors of the Holy Nation, based at Okran's Shield.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Battle prayers to Okran; promises to purge darkness.
